system.description:
Favoured weapon: Morningstar

Granted power: Once/day: enter a willing creature's dream during a long rest and communicate freely within it.

  • Advantage on Insight checks.
  • Once per encounter, a creature you hit with your morningstar makes a Will save or cannot take reactions until the end of its next turn.

Allegiance: Chaotic Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Selûne in the World of Arneyan wiki.
